description: Trigger the smart-week content generation engine for a specific date. This immediately queues posts for that day's schedule configuration. Use YYYY-MM-DD format for the date. Returns postsCreated count.

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Set the brand's standing language with set_brand_content_language instead when every future generation should use it.

name: run_weekly_schedule_day
